Ask for the details that change how you prepare

Start with a service preset and keep the questions that affect staffing, equipment, timing or the welcome you give the client. Use the customer’s own vocabulary and ask one thing at a time. Copy the final questions into your booking form or print a sheet to complete together at check-in.

Add intake questions to Shopify bookings →

Worked example

A portrait photographer might ask “How many people will be photographed?”, “Who needs an individual portrait?” and “Where will you use the finished photos?” Those three answers help the studio plan the backdrop, shot list and appointment length.

Common questions

Can I use the questions in a Shopify booking form?

Yes. Copy the final wording into the question fields in your booking app, then set any required answers there. Preview the booking as a customer to check the order.

Where do clients submit their answers?

The builder creates a reusable set of questions and a printable form. Collect digital responses through the booking form you publish, or let clients complete a paper copy at the appointment.
